NODE.label: NODE: printed sockets on a carbon ladder
NODE.look: Organic printed knuckles at every junction with root fingers flowing along the tubes; tubes bonded straight into the prints. The simplest build.

TENDON.label: TENDON: printed knuckles with carbon tendon wraps
TENDON.look: The NODE knuckles, with tapered carbon-twill 'tendons' laid from each knuckle onto its tubes: printed bone, carbon sinew. The wrap carries the joint load.
